Product launch pages with immersive 3D elements

ai_summary: A futuristic hero section featuring an animated aurora gradient background with morphing colors (green, blue, purple, pink), 3D animated stars from React Three Fiber, and a SaaS-focused headline. The component uses Framer Motion for smooth color transitions and interactive button effects with glowing borders. Designed for high-conversion landing pages with a modern dark aesthetic.
